description: One record per NASA combustion test row from PSI experimental tables (plus Saffire IV–VI from NASA ICES-2024-365). Units converted in code: mmHg, atm and bar to kPa; mole fraction to percent. Raw cells kept in `raw`.

quirks.note: Subscripts were lost in the column names; 'O', 'N' and 'CO' are O₂, N₂ and CO₂
examples: O / N / CO / He initial ambient composition

quirks.note: Values (0.05–1.06) are droplet burning-rate constants, normally in mm²/s; the unit's superscript appears lost
Two-digit year in a column that mostly uses four digits
Unreadable character in the cell
Unreadable character in the cell
Pressure of 0 mmHg is not physical for a burning test
The table lists the planned range for each fuel, not individual tests
quirks.action: kept as a test matrix, not plotted as tests

quirks.note: Inconsistent spelling of yes/no values
quirks.action: normalised case; 'flash' kept as its own outcome

quirks.note: 3 tests list 'RAMPED' instead of a number
quirks.action: kept as text; derived values left empty

quirks.note: Oxygen levels are listed per test day, not per flame, and only for flames that ignited
quirks.action: one record per day and oxygen level; flame count is per day

quirks.note: Spreadsheet percent formatting multiplied the value by 100
Spreadsheet autofill turned 'N2' into an incrementing label
Spreadsheet autofill turned 'N2' into an incrementing label
Spreadsheet autofill incremented the chemical formula down the column (26 rows)
quirks.action: read as CH₄ or C₂H₄, matching each row's test type; original kept in raw

quirks.note: The same test day appears twice with identical values
Notes typed into the date column
quirks.action: date kept; note kept in raw

quirks.note: Rows repeat exactly (same ignition, fuel and flow)
quirks.action: kept; each row may be a separate condition within one ignition

quirks.note: Implausible final oxygen for a cabin-scale test (outside 10–25%)
Text and negative values in numeric gas columns
quirks.action: left empty; text kept as a flag

quirks.note: Several flow settings written in one cell
quirks.action: parsed in order as flow settings; first used as the test's flow

Material cell left blank

Conditions given as 'same as 1–4' instead of values
